title: Fixed Continuous Half Twist Band and Low Plinth
description: One wholly newly authored complete fixed half-twisted ribbon sculpture on its own low plinth. A single continuous broad finite-thickness band follows a full upright circular centre path while its rectangular cross-section turns through half a turn over the circuit. The final section reconnects to opposite cross-section vertices of the first section, leaving a closed shared-vertex material volume without duplicate end caps, separated bow pieces or interwoven rails. Broad satin faces and the narrow cut-edge surface have distinct opaque materials; the entire middle opening remains real empty space. The lowest part of the band roots directly into one low capped plinth with a full flat ground sole. Unlike the gift parcel, this has no untwisted planar wrapping loops, paired bow loops or box; unlike the old two-rail braided portal, it has one wide twisting material band, no second winding rail, bridges, four arch ends or passage threshold. All vertices newly drawn, not an old gift bow extracted and stood up. One complete cultural-display sculpture zero scenes, four opaque untextured PBR roles, metres Z up and whole horizontal bounds centre. A generic Mobius-inspired artistic form only, not a mathematical theorem, exact topology teaching model, deformable ribbon, historical artwork replica, physical equilibrium, structural capacity, public installation or safe traversal claim. No person, text, transparency, animation, rigging or interaction.
